meta.title: Hidden Edge - 2
meta.description: Facing the foe head on can be a wise strategy too.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Sister...</color>
units.displayText: Sister...

spans.text: Sister...

units.rawText: What seems to be the matter, my dear sister?
units.displayText: What seems to be the matter, my dear sister?

spans.text: What seems to be the matter, my dear sister?

units.rawText: <color=purple>They still... haven't come... I... have Turing...</color>
units.displayText: They still... haven't come... I... have Turing...

spans.text: They still... haven't come... I... have Turing...

units.rawText: Mm, hm, one does need patience as the audience enters.
units.displayText: Mm, hm, one does need patience as the audience enters.

spans.text: Mm, hm, one does need patience as the audience enters.

units.rawText: But our patience is very limited. Hail them again after five minutes and see how they answer.
units.displayText: But our patience is very limited. Hail them again after five minutes and see how they answer.

spans.text: But our patience is very limited. Hail them again after five minutes and see how they answer.

units.rawText: Are things alright near the Data Center?
units.displayText: Are things alright near the Data Center?

spans.text: Are things alright near the Data Center?

units.rawText: <color=purple>Someone is constantly watching... There are no signs of an attack.</color>
units.displayText: Someone is constantly watching... There are no signs of an attack.

spans.text: Someone is constantly watching... There are no signs of an attack.

units.rawText: Good, good, you've done very well. I expected nothing less of my dear sister...
units.displayText: Good, good, you've done very well. I expected nothing less of my dear sister...

spans.text: Good, good, you've done very well. I expected nothing less of my dear sister...

units.rawText: Once you come back I shall shower you with all my affection.
units.displayText: Once you come back I shall shower you with all my affection.

spans.text: Once you come back I shall shower you with all my affection.

units.rawText: But before that—I need to take care of some "obstacles" here...
units.displayText: But before that—I need to take care of some "obstacles" here...

spans.text: But before that—I need to take care of some "obstacles" here...

units.rawText: Ting!
units.displayText: Ting!

spans.text: Ting!

units.rawText: Odile turns and spreads her wings, just in time to deflect a bullet fired by an agent.
units.displayText: Odile turns and spreads her wings, just in time to deflect a bullet fired by an agent.

spans.text: Odile turns and spreads her wings, just in time to deflect a bullet fired by an agent.

units.rawText: Are you done with the monologue?
units.displayText: Are you done with the monologue?

spans.text: Are you done with the monologue?

units.rawText: Odile smiles, but it is not reflected in her eyes.
units.displayText: Odile smiles, but it is not reflected in her eyes.

spans.text: Odile smiles, but it is not reflected in her eyes.

units.rawText: Wandering backstage is taboo for the audience, you know.
units.displayText: Wandering backstage is taboo for the audience, you know.

spans.text: Wandering backstage is taboo for the audience, you know.

units.rawText: What right do you have to criticize me when you do not understand the depth of the script?
units.displayText: What right do you have to criticize me when you do not understand the depth of the script?

spans.text: What right do you have to criticize me when you do not understand the depth of the script?

units.rawText: I might not understand its depth, but I do know that this show will end with your death.
units.displayText: I might not understand its depth, but I do know that this show will end with your death.

spans.text: I might not understand its depth, but I do know that this show will end with your death.

units.rawText: Hehe, and here I thought you cast your knight aside. To think this would turn out to be an infiltration scene instead.
units.displayText: Hehe, and here I thought you cast your knight aside. To think this would turn out to be an infiltration scene instead.

spans.text: Hehe, and here I thought you cast your knight aside. To think this would turn out to be an infiltration scene instead.

units.rawText: While your courage is admirable, you will soon pay the appropriate price for your lack of self-awareness.
units.displayText: While your courage is admirable, you will soon pay the appropriate price for your lack of self-awareness.
